sources.source: U.S. Census Bureau, Monthly Retail Trade: Jewelry Stores (NAICS 44831), not seasonally adjusted, via FRED MRTSSM44831USN; monthly sales ÷ that year's monthly mean, averaged over 2017-2019 (last full pre-2020 years; the series ends in 2021 with the NAICS 2022 revision)
Gupta Media, Meta (Facebook + Instagram) average CPM by month, 2024 and 2025; each month ÷ that year's monthly mean, averaged over the two years

note: Indexes are relative to an average month (mean 1.0). Applied as a prior for the month being planned; never used to calibrate or backtest, because one year of a brand's history cannot separate seasonality from everything else.
